verdict.rationale: The only first-party bulk action in the evidence is the Policies page's "Publish draft policies" button, which publishes every draft that doesn't require review in one step. The one-click secure baseline sets org-wide device policy rather than acting on many items, and the MCP server and service keys are building blocks with no documented bulk operations. missing for 10: general multi-select or bulk edit across item types (findings, controls, devices, members), bulk operations exposed via the MCP server or API for AI agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
